directory.description: A directory in which the module is added.
directory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create the module in?

name.description: The name of the module, as separate words joined by `-`, `_`, or spaces. `Module` is appended to the generated class name.

bundler.description: The bundler to use. Choosing 'none' means this library is not buildable.

importPath.description: The library name used to import it, like @myorg/my-native-module. Required for publishable library.

homepage.description: The URL of the homepage. For example, `https://docs.expo.dev/modules/.`

description.description: A longer description of the module, used for the iOS podspec.

summary.description: A one-line summary of the module.

author.description: The author of the module, used for the iOS podspec.

androidNamespace.description: The namespace in which to put your module on Android. For example, `dev.expo.mynativemodule`.
